title: English Practice Quiz 0435
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.

questions.question: A colleague asks for help. A polite reply is:
questions.explanation: Certainly. What do you need? is helpful and polite.

questions.question: Which question asks for a reason?
The work ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.question: He decided ___ early.
questions.explanation: Decide is commonly followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
You need a moment to think. You say:
options: Let me think for a moment.
questions.explanation: This phrase politely signals that you need a little time.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use does + subject + base verb with he, she or it.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'The manager signed the letter.'
options: The letter was signed by the manager.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + past participle.
